items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So he records a lot of people, you know, when they come over there.

ctx.x: They don't have distribution, really, they don't have distribution here. And this , man, you wouldn't believe it. I'm going to bring you and let you hear it and this cat, man, whoo, he plays. Now when he goes to Dixie, he doesn't play as much as he does on this record. I think he's a little scared when he -- I asked him a couple of times, I said, "Roy, you comfortable?" "Yeah, yeah, I'm all right, I'm all right." He says, "Am I doing all right?" I say, "Yeah, you're doing all right." But man, I want you to hear…
